entities.summary: Ibak Khan, born Sayyid Ibrahim Khan was a Shaybanid khan of Sibir about whom the sources are contradictory. He is also called Abak, Ivak, Ibaq, Khan of Tyumen, and possibly Said Ibrakhim Khan.
